description: This Java test class, named 'BaseCustomizableMetadataTest', contains unit tests for the 'BaseCustomizableMetadata' class within the OpenMRS project. The tests verify the behavior of setting attributes on provider objects, especially handling attribute replacement based on attribute type and max occurrence constraints, and ensure proper handling of attribute value updates.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableMetadataTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing functionalities of BaseCustomizableMetadata, such as setting attributes and handling attribute replacement logic.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Runs before each test to initialize the provider service and load XML datasets into the test context.

methods.name: setAttribute_shouldVoidTheAttributeIfAnAttributeWithSameAttributeTypeAlreadyExistsAndTheMaxOccursIsSetTo1
methods.description: Tests that setting an attribute with the same type replaces the existing one and voids the previous attribute if max occurs is set to 1.

methods.name: setAttribute_shouldWorkForAttriubutesWithDatatypesWhoseValuesAreStoredInOtherTables
methods.description: Verifies that setting attributes with complex data types stored in other tables works correctly, including voiding previous attributes.

methods.name: buildProviderAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to create and populate ProviderAttribute instances with a specified type and value.
